title: Tests pin the pack index's unit cache: cached equals fresh, each key input re-weighs, an edited fact is found
goal: Within the tests ceiling, a test shows that weighed() from the unit cache equals a fresh weighing, that a change to each _unit_key input re-weighs that unit, and that an edited fact is found by rag.py pack, so a regression of the cache shows in the suite on any host; found by the SP-kjqdiudr review (ST-akicahgy).
